fields.label: Department
fields.note: careerportalinfo.jobListingSetting.filters = ["department","location"]; the Keka embed widget filters the single unfiltered active feed client-side, so no query parameter carries the department.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: Second configured portal filter; values are the locations published on the active feed.

notes: webengage.com/careers/ 301-redirects to /current-openings/, which inlines window.khConfig (identifier db770a22-93d1-46f6-af73-c35e960ea796, domain https://webklipper.keka.com/careers/, target #khembedjobs) and loads the Keka embedjobs widget. Membership is the unfiltered GET https://webklipper.keka.com/careers/api/embedjobs/default/active/db770a22-93d1-46f6-af73-c35e960ea796 (26 rows); the portal is configured with exactly two filters, department and location (plus displayed fields location/experience/jobType), and the widget applies them in the browser with no pagination — so there is no native query string and the scraper filters locally. jobType ids map {1:'Part Time', 2:'Full Time'}.
evidence: https://webengage.com/careers/ -> 301 -> https://webengage.com/current-openings/ (HTTP 200); khConfig identifier db770a22-93d1-46f6-af73-c35e960ea796, embedjobs script api/embedjobs/js/<identifier>

https://webklipper.keka.com/careers/api/organization/default/careerportalinfo -> HTTP 200, name WebEngage, jobListingSetting.filters = ["department","location"], jobFields = ["location","experience","jobType"], jobListingFormat 1
